import sys, json, time, subprocess, resource, os

def timed(label, raw):
    t=time.time()
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','/workspace/project/main.py'],input=raw,capture_output=True)
    dt=time.time()-t
    ru=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
    try:
        out=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
    except Exception:
        out={'raw':p.stdout[:200].decode('utf8','replace'),'err':p.stderr.decode()[:500]}
    if isinstance(out,dict) and 'channels' in out:
        summary={'chan':[{'n':c['bytes']['n'],'reqs':len(c['requests'])} for c in out['channels']][:3],
                 'ncases':len(out['cases'])}
    else:
        summary=out
    print('%-30s %6.2fs maxrss=%dMB %s' % (label, dt, ru.ru_maxrss//1024, json.dumps(summary)[:200]))

def doc(**kw):
    d={"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":10,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[]}
    d.update(kw); return json.dumps(d).encode()

case_a=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"]],"End_Stream":True}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/x","host":"h.example"}}]

# 50000 parts in one channel
parts=[{"case":"a","data":"x"} for _ in range(49998)]
d = doc(cases=case_a, channels=[{"name":"c","parts":parts}])
timed('50000 parts', d)

# 8MiB input
big = "GET /x HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\n\r\n"
n = (8*1024*1024 - 2000)//len(big)
d = doc(cases=case_a, channels=[{"name":"c","parts":[{"case":"a","data":big*n}]}])
print('input size', len(d))
timed('8MiB input', d)

# many definitions with slices
defs=[["A0","b'0123456789abcdef'"]]
for i in range(1,8192):
    defs.append(["A%d"%i, "A%d[0:8]"%(i-1)])
d = doc(definitions=defs, cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{A8191}}","End_Stream":True}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}}])
timed('8192 sliced defs', d)

# 2000 cases with frames
cases=[{"name":"c%d"%i,"frames":[{"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"]],"End_Stream":True}],"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}} for i in range(2000)]
d = doc(cases=cases)
timed('2000 cases', d)

# 50000 events with data
events=[{"at":i,"kind":"data","stream":0,"data":"x"*10,"end":False} for i in range(50000)]
d = doc(cases=case_a, events=events)
timed('50000 data events', d)
